news.contents: Indianapolis Colts quarterback Anthony Richardson Sr., who saw his first action of the 2026 season in Week 8 against Jacksonville, may soon have fantasy relevance as the potential trade of quarterback Daniel Jones looms. Additionally, it's possible that Richardson himself is dealt. Regardless, the 2024 fourth overall pick, who has played 18 career games and started only in 2024, is itching for another opportunity. news.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. Could Emerge as a Waiver-Wire Target

news.analysis: Irving scored on rushes of two and six yards in the close loss, giving him five touchdowns over his past three games. The veteran running back has been one of the few bright spots on a disappointing Tampa Bay offense this season, posting 825 rushing yards and eight all-purpose touchdowns in nine contests. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.
news.contents: Bucky Irving carried the ball 20 times for 97 yards and two touchdowns while catching four of his five targets for 28 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.title: Bucky Irving scores two TDs in Week 9 loss

news.contents: Tampa Bay Buccaneers running back Bucky Irving is on pace for a career-high 315 carries in 2026. Head coach Todd Bowles said he does not know if Irving can sustain that heavy a workload, so the team might work to lessen his workload in the second half of the season to preserve his health and make sure he is healthy to the end, according to Greg Auman of FOX Sports. In the 27-24 loss to the Chicago Bears on Sunday night, the 24-year-old had 20 rushing attempts for 97 yards and two touchdowns ...
news.title: Bucky Irving's Workload May Decrease to Preserve his Health

news.analysis: Despite having four carries fewer than fellow running back Kyren Williams, Corum outproduced Williams by 13 yards on the ground. Corum started the season as a high-end handcuff, but now is a high floor RB3/Flex play weekly. Corum will look to continue this momentum in Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.
news.contents: Blake Corum rushed 11 times for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
news.title: Blake Corum hits paydirt in win

news.contents: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua was targeted on 19 of Matthew Stafford's 43 pass attempts Sunday. He turned that workload into 14 catches for a season-high 150 yards and a touchdown in the Rams' 20-13 Week 9 win over the Washington Commanders, adding 20 yards on two carries. Nacua converted a fourth-and-three with a 15-yard catch to help set up a field goal before halftime. He caught two passes for 27 yards on the opening drive of the second half, which ended with a Blake Corum ...
news.title: Puka Nacua's Target Volume Keeps Him an Elite WR1

news.analysis: Nabers didn't have a great game to his standards on Sunday. He finished with under 50 yards in this win over the Eagles, and he wasn't able to bring in a nice touchdown that would've been the highlight play of the day. He should bounce back and return to form in the very near future, however.
news.contents: Malik Nabers caught 5-of-8 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.title: Malik Nabers underwhelming in win Sunday

There was a bit of panic last week when Nabers missed Thursday's practice due to a knee injury, but the 23-year-old returned to the field on Friday and was cleared to play in the Week 9 win over the division-rival Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday, when he caught five of his eight targets for 43 yards. news.analysis: Egbuka was dealing with a foot injury throughout the week and was listed as questionable for the game before ultimately suiting up. The second-year wideout has 31 catches for 278 yards and two touchdowns in seven games this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.
news.contents: Emeka Egbuka caught three of his five targets for 38 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9. He also gained one yard on his lone rush in the loss.
news.title: Emeka Egbuka hauls in three passes in Week 9

news.contents: Tampa Bay Buccaneers wide receiver Emeka Egbuka caught three of his five targets for 38 yards during Sunday's Week 9 loss against the Chicago Bears. Fantasy managers were hoping Egbuka would take the next step into the No. 1 receiver role this season with Mike Evans gone, but so far, the Ohio State product has shown no indication that he can be a consistent alpha receiver in this Bucs offense. Unfortunately for Tampa Bay, Chris Godwin Jr. has also been disappointing, leaving no clear answer ...
news.title: Emeka Egbuka Falls Short of Expectations in Week 9

news.analysis: Bowers remains the most consistent part of the Raiders offense on a week-to-week basis. He did lose a fumble on the day, but otherwise had another big day for fantasy managers.
news.contents: Brock Bowers caught 7-of-8 targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.title: Brock Bowers continues to dominate Sunday

news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders tight end Brock Bowers leaves little doubt that he is an elite fantasy football tight end, as he once again had high production with seven receptions (on eight targets) for 111 yards and a touchdown in a 38-17 loss to the San Francisco 49ers in Week 9. Bowers added one rushing attempt for two yards. It was a blowout loss for the Raiders, and Bowers and quarterback Kirk Cousins tend to do a lot of damage while playing catch-up, but fantasy managers won't mind that. Through ...
news.title: Brock Bowers Continues to Produce at High Level

news.analysis: Santos hit field goals from 25 and 38 yards out, with the second kick serving as the game-winner as time expired. Santos has made 15 of his 19 field-goal attempts this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Saints in Week 11.
news.contents: Cairo Santos made both of his field goals and added three extra points in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.title: Cairo Santos makes two FGs in Week 9

news.contents: New York Jets running back Braelon Allen got eight carries with Breece Hall (quad) back in the lineup Sunday. Allen ran for 33 yards and caught both of his targets for 21 yards in the 35-12 Week 9 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs. His 19-yard catch came on the opening drive, and he lost a yard on a carry from the Kansas City four-yard line later in that possession. Nick Bolton forced an Allen fumble in the second quarter, and the Chiefs scored two plays later. Allen finished with 5.4 PPR points ...

news.contents: Tennessee Titans wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson returns from his Week 9 bye to face Jacksonville on Sunday. Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown against Cincinnati in Week 8. He has drawn at least six targets in four straight games, although he's managed just 262 receiving yards through eight contests. Jacksonville has allowed 12.5 receptions per game to opposing wide receivers, the seventh-most in the NFL. Robinson also played 94% of Tennessee's offensive snaps ...
